title: Daily sensor observations of spheres off the East Coast
summary: Merrick tells of Daily sensor observations of spheres off the East Coast, about 2014-2015 at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this is amid daily um uh observations or or you know, sensor observations of spherical objects off the east coast

plain: A witness named Merrick, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025, passes on what he credits to a man named Ryan Graves. According to him, around 2014 and 2015, sensors off the US East Coast were picking up round, sphere-shaped objects every day. If true, it would mean unknown objects were being tracked routinely near the American coast.
